issues.description:
I am writing to raise a concern about the street sweeping schedule in my neighborhood. The sweeping currently begins every Friday very early in the morning, often before 5:00 a.m., and the noise consistently disturbs my sleep.

While I understand and appreciate the importance of keeping our streets clean, the current timing is having a negative effect on residents’ rest, health, and overall quality of life. Many neighbors I have spoken with share the same concern.

Sine 5th Avenue is no more commercial zone I respectfully request that the street sweeping schedule be adjusted to a later time in the morning, or that alternative methods be considered to minimize noise during early hours. A small change in timing could make a significant difference for the well-being of the community.

It seems that some people are either not aware of street sweeping schedule or do not care and park their cars on the street which makes this whole operation a lot less effective.
Thank you for your attention to this matter, and I look forward to your response.

issues.description:
I am writing to request the installation of a "No Public Overnight Parking" sign at the entrance of Redwood Village. Our neighborhood has increasingly become an overnight parking area for non-residents who park multiple work and personal vehicles here. While we understand that the adjacent public park generates daytime traffic, the issue intensifies after the park closes at dark. Vehicles come and go throughout the night, creating noise disturbances, diminishing the neighborhood's appearance, and occupying parking spaces needed by residents. A clearly posted sign restricting overnight public parking would help deter this activity and preserve the quality of life for Redwood Village residents.

Thank you for considering this request. Please let me know if you need any additional information.
